desc: Parse input and split foods into three lists according to `V_i`.
For each vitamin list, compute a DP array `dp[c]` = maximum vitamin amount achievable with at most `c` calories, using descending calorie loops for 0/1 knapsack.
Make each DP array nondecreasing by prefix-maximum over calorie budgets, so `dp[c]` is the best amount for capacity `c`.
Implement `can(T)` that finds the smallest calorie budget for each vitamin where `dp[c] >= T`, and returns true iff the sum of these three budgets is at most `X`.
Binary search the answer over `[0, min(dp1[X], dp2[X], dp3[X])]` using `can(T)`, then print the maximum feasible value.
Handle edge cases explicitly: empty vitamin groups, target values larger than any group can achieve, and at-most calorie usage rather than exact calorie usage.
